currentNotes.SHELL-01: It ran.  But took a while to load.
currentNotes.SHELL-02: In File it has "Exit".  It would be good to have a "Close" option so you can close the dashboard without exiting the application
currentNotes.SHELL-04: Pass however dropdown is crowding lable
currentNotes.THEME-01: Light/Dark theme switching doesn't work from Settings | Appearance but does work using switch on main screen
currentNotes.FILE-05: I opened and new dashboard (C:\dev\homeassistant2\dashboards\uat_dashboard.yaml).  At first the dashboard opened as expected
currentNotes.FILE-04: I opened and new dashboard (C:\dev\homeassistant2\dashboards\uat_dashboard.yaml).  At first the dashboard opened as expected.  However when I created a new button on the canvas the dashboard reverted back to the template dashboard that I had previously created.  Expected behavior would be if there is an existing dashboard open (dirty state) if I try to open or create another dashboard, a "Do you want to save" dialogue should be displayed to allow users to save.  If user answers no, existing dashboard is discarded.  If yes then save or save as process is activated.  In any event, if a new dashboard is created or opened, previous loaded dashboards should not be loaded.
currentNotes.CLIP-02: I changed the name of the copied card and got an alert from Acronis Active Protection.  Affected file is c:\Users\micah\AppData\Roaming\HA Visual Dashboard Maker\config.json.  I 'ignored' the notification
currentNotes.CLIP-04: When selecting two cards all properties are shown.  When selecting all three just the last clicked one is shown.
currentNotes.VIEWS-05: Could not resize with handle.  Dialogue with sliders appears when clicking on a card
currentNotes.THEME-02: Can't change the values of a theme to be able to save it as something different (i.e. no custom theme creator).  Also, changing the them only changes the background colour behind the canvas.
currentNotes.VCS-02: No ability to change repo once one is already selected (you can only forget)
currentNotes.HA-02: Filtering not working properly.  Also "X/page" does not work.  When selecting "Integration" and searching for kia only one entity is listed but there are 41 Kia Uvo integration entities.
currentNotes.HA-03: Some cards come up with error.  Spacing and sizes are wrong.  A number of other issues
currentNotes.HA-04: Not enough information to be able to map the missing entities.  It would be helpful have the integration that the entity belongs to so I could find the mapping.  Auto-map doesn't work
currentNotes.HA-08: Address for preview is hidden under cards and even when it is not it cannot be copied.  Better option would be when the user clicks "Live Preview" a dialog with the address is shown with the option to copy it to clipboard and instruction on what to do and what the user should see.
currentNotes.HA-07: Clicking deploy did not provide a summary of what would be done and list adjustments.  It just deployed the dashboard.  When viewing the dashboard in HA
currentNotes.HA-09: Not done.  Too many issues to be able to build a functioning dashboard (i.e. entity mapping is broken so creating a dashboard without being able to effectively search and select entities is not possible).
